accuracyFlags: Table gives low-cost traveller $85-$135/day but section 06 and its 'Keep in mind' say frugal is $80 to $130: the two ranges contradict each other.
Sources include Nomads.com and crowd-sourced Numbeo as the main cost benchmarks; no official source for fuel, park or accommodation components.

Footer blurb says 'Find 74,000+ Australian places offline': AussieCamps is not an offline map; only place details and guides work offline, and the 74,000 total is out of scope but the wording should say 'place details and guides work offline'.
